name: monorepo
description: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo starter with Cloudflare Workers, Hono HTTP gateway, and React (Vite) frontend.

scripts.ci: pnpm run boundaries && cross-env VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://worker-api-ci.monorepo-template.workers.dev turbo run //#lint:check //#format:check //#deps:check //#deps:format:check //#knip //#knip:production types:check check-types test build --continue=dependencies-successful && pnpm run audit
scripts.ci:affected: pnpm run boundaries && cross-env VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://worker-api-ci.monorepo-template.workers.dev turbo run //#lint:check //#format:check //#deps:check //#deps:format:check types:check check-types test build --affected --continue=dependencies-successful
scripts.ci:agent: pnpm run boundaries && cross-env TURBO_UI=false VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://worker-api-ci.monorepo-template.workers.dev turbo run //#lint:agent //#format:check //#deps:check //#deps:format:check //#knip:agent //#knip:production types:check check-types test build --continue=dependencies-successful --output-logs=errors-only --log-order=grouped && pnpm run audit
scripts.ci:sandbox: pnpm run boundaries && cross-env TURBO_UI=false turbo run //#lint:agent //#format:check //#deps:check //#deps:format:check //#knip:agent //#knip:production types:check check-types test --continue=dependencies-successful --output-logs=errors-only --log-order=grouped && pnpm run audit
scripts.fix: pnpm run deps:fix && pnpm run deps:format && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format:fix
